# School_Management_System

> A learning-focused school administration and fee management platform built with ASP.NET Core, Blazor Interactive Server, EF Core, and MySQL.

## Project documents

- [README](README.md): current repository status, planned stack, and module overview
- [Implementation plan](plan.md): architecture, roles, data model, workflows, calculations, and seven-phase roadmap
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): implementation workflow, coding guidance, and data-protection rules
- [Full AI context](llms-full.txt): expanded project summary
- [MIT License](LICENSE): repository license

## Current status

Phases 1–7 are implemented in source. Phase 7 adds grade-calculation unit tests, SQLite workflow tests for admissions, marks, and payments, a NuGet vulnerability audit, CI migration and production-startup checks against MySQL 8.4, health endpoints, Docker Compose deployment files, explicit production migrations, and MySQL backup tooling. All 10 local tests passed with no reported vulnerable packages; migrations applied to a disposable MySQL 8.4 instance, and Production health returned `ready` and `live`. The Phase 6 migration remains unapplied to the developer's local MySQL because its supplied login was rejected. Browser walkthroughs and production deployment remain pending. SSLCOMMERZ needs sandbox credentials and a public HTTPS callback host; SMTP needs local credentials.
